faqs.question: What does the Fungal stain test - Hair measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal organisms in hair samples using the stains KOH & Calcofluor White.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal stain test - Hair done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal infections of the hair and scalp • To monitor the effectiveness of treatment for fungal infections • To identify other conditions related to fungal infections

faqs.question: When is the Fungal stain test - Hair recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may recommend this test if you have • symptoms such as itching, redness, or scaling on your scalp or other areas of your body, • a suspected fungal infection on your hair or scalp, • a previous diagnosis of a fungal infection and need monitoring, or • a compromised immune system, which increases the risk of fungal infections.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal stain test - Hair are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may suggest the presence of a fungal infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal stain test - Hair?
faqs.answer: During this test, a small sample of your hair will be collected in a sterile container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for testing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal stain test - Hair?
faqs.answer: • Do not wash your hair for at least 24 hours before the test. • Inform your doctor about any antifungal medications you may be taking. Also, tell them if you have any specific requirements. • Follow any specific instructions provided by your doctor regarding hair care or preparing the sample.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Fungal stain test - Hair?
faqs.answer: • Culture and sensitivity test: To identify the specific species of fungus causing the infection and determine which antifungal medications are most effective • Skin biopsy: If needed, a small piece of skin from the affected area may be removed for further examination under a microscope

faqs.question: What is Fungal stain by KOH & Calcofluor White stain - Hair also known as?
faqs.answer: Fungal smear microscopy or Dermatophyte Test Medium (DTM) culture

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection of the hair and scalp?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection of the hair and scalp, also known as tinea capitis, is a common condition caused by various types of fungi. It leads to symptoms such as itching, redness, scaling, and hair loss.
